sv.title: Hackkycklingen har blivit folkkär
sv.summary: Trenden har pekat ditåt ett tag, men nu har det till slut hänt: Moderaterna är Sveriges största parti i en opinionsmätning.

en.title: Hack chicken has become popular
en.summary: The trend has been pointing that way for a while, but now it has finally happened: the Moderates are Sweden's largest party in an opinion poll.
